protocol: count-level; only people whose bounding-box height is at least min_height pixels in the source 854x480 resolution are counted; a 60px reference bar was rendered into each frame as a yardstick
uncertainty: +/-1 person per frame on borderline cases
known_issues: Frame 1884 labelled 5; two independent detectors found 9 and visual review confirmed ~8-9. Label biased low.
Single annotator, no calibration pass, borderline cases resolved conservatively in one direction.
Count-level only; does not verify box placement.
N=3 frames is too small to separate models.
do_not_use_for: any published accuracy claim, or ranking detector backends
